decisions.reason: The flagship organic salami platter line sits at the core of the firm's organic expansion and is cheap to maintain on existing processes, and with no negative signals the option stays open.

Visibility of the organic poultry mini salami snack did not grow beyond its own page in its second year and the niche snack format risks retail delisting, but keeping it costs little while results resolve.
The premium sharing salami line runs on established processes, and two years of evidence show no clear failure, so abandonment is not yet justified.
The organic Fleischwurst is newly launched and explicitly promoted as part of the organic team, so its value is still uncertain and the low holding cost favors keeping it.
The organic thinly sliced chicken line with two variants was just launched and extends the organic direction, so it is too early to judge and the option is kept open.
The organic herb-coated salami is close to the core offer, cheap to keep and has only one year of evidence, so it is kept while uncertainty resolves.
